requirement_text.REQ-378: See handoffs/WF03-ISS0736-20260921/step-00-git-setup.json context.requirement_text.REQ-378 for the full verbatim requirement text (already committed to main at fb6a8d43 and present on this branch). Summary: acceptance criteria are (1) a tenant_admin action revoking a signed-in business_user's access takes effect on that user's very next request with no sign-out/reload/token-expiry wait, demonstrated by a revoke-then-immediately-retry test with no sleep/token refresh; (2) the revoking action is reachable through Letflow's own web/ GUI, not only Keycloak; (3) the resulting 403 renders through the existing QueryStateBoundary/PermissionDenied contract unchanged; (4) SECURITY-REVIEWER signs off explicitly on the chosen enforcement mechanism before merge.
